review_resolved: 8842c770f167 (PASS; findings F1 and F2 low), by Decision 0143

components.scope: component, store, host-unit, wire and CLI row: operational store migration 25 keeps each coding run's effect record in an append-only chain at a position of its session and replays every chain at open; the persisted recorder stores each kept execution and change record after memory and remembers a store refusal; the session declaration is built from the stored chains of every run of the session, each change record read back as that run's own verified record, and refused for an incomplete chain, an unreleased earlier run, a run resumed after a restart or an unreadable record; the service asks for it for every ended run, the wire carries it in run declarations schema 5, and the CLI verifies it as a session declaration and shows it after the run's own in both formats. The boundary glue, its artifact reads and the factory's composition run only on a native Linux host, which this sandbox refuses, so no actual process stored or declared a session's effects

mutation_checks: run on the exact source commit 90ca140c after its source stage, with private tooling that applies one exact replacement, runs the package's filtered library tests and restores the file; the specification and results are attached to the batch28-source stage. 19 single mutations, 18 caught: in the session declaration an unreleased earlier run, a released declaring run and an incomplete chain accepted, the read bound ignored, an unknown outcome stored as success, a store refusal forgotten, a restart not marked, a publication not stored and the stored chain used after a memory miss; in the client a session report naming a run, an unverified session report and an unshown session report; the restart start mapped to a continuation; a resumed run's session declaration withheld; and in the store an unchecked policy digest, an unchecked session position, a non-canonical record and an unknown outcome claiming a change. The survivor, a change record's producing run left unchecked, was caught after the test commit d6d409de added the case it needed (1 of 1 on rerun, attached to the batch28-source-test stage). The tree was verified identical afterwards
